lines.2: The cruiser roared to life and pulled away.
lines.3: Even though we were still standing on the beach.
lines.4: 「Well then, you two. Play nice. I am heading home.」
lines.6: 「I will take responsibility for contacting your parents.」
lines.8: 「Heh heh heh. I told you to leave it to me.」
lines.9: 「I saw it in a movie. Apparently if you leave two people stranded together like this, all sorts of romance blossoms.」
lines.11: 「...Wait, is there actually a movie like that?」
lines.12: 「Stranded on a deserted island... Maybe you mean "Crying Out with My Little Brother in the Center of Kamakura," the one starring Honami Inugami?」
lines.15: 「I will come pick you up tomorrow evening!」
lines.20: Our cries were in vain as the cruiser disappeared into the distance.
lines.22: The Principal had stranded one boy and one girl on a deserted island.
lines.23: Playing matchmaker and making us survive in the wild were two different things.
lines.24: 「I'm seriously starting to doubt the Principal knows the first thing about women...」
lines.25: 「Didn't he say he doesn't even have a wife?」
lines.29: 「Ever heard of repaying a kindness with betrayal?」
lines.31: 「I never thought the Principal had something this insane in mind.」
lines.32: 「Why am I going through this on the first day after exams...」
